theme: An open Sunday bracing for a full Monday.
greeting: A quiet one, Dan — nothing on the calendar but a birthday note. The work worth a glance tonight is the short list that spills into tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Eugenia
needsAttention.detail: On the PRI thread she offered Monday noon–2 or Thursday morning your time and is waiting to hear which. The Monday slot is tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Confirm Mike's pre-op details
needsAttention.detail: His oral surgery is Thursday in Portland; pre-op instructions were meant to be confirmed by tomorrow, driver and insurance by Tuesday. The task has been open since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: Prep the 2 PM with Mike
needsAttention.detail: You and Mike follow up at 2 PM tomorrow. He forwarded the Morningstar–Sustainalytics stewardship wind-down and floated reaching out to its abandoned clients — worth arriving with a view.

needsAttention.title: Buy the Croatia flights
needsAttention.detail: The task came due Aug 15 and is now a day overdue; fares tend to climb the longer it sits.

schedule.title: Milica Boskovic's birthday
schedule.detail: A note on your calendar today

flagged.title: SVP Global Public Policy update
flagged.detail: A recruiter note on the Senior VP of Global Public Policy role asks you to confirm work authorization to keep the application moving — check the sender before clicking.

flagged.title: Talkiatry visit Tuesday
flagged.detail: Your next follow-up with Dr. Snowden is a virtual visit Tuesday at 10 AM ET.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail — WSJ, The New Yorker, NYT Cooking, an Amex paperless nudge, Chairish, and a few sales.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: A still Sunday — the calendar holds only a birthday note.
Nothing scheduled, so the open hours are yours to shape.
Monday looms fuller — an early networking window and an afternoon call to keep in mind.
